div.head: Wi 17
div.ab: Mynstres aldor hine cænne in preostes canne.
Mynstres aldor hine cænne in preostes canne.
Mynstres aldor hine cænne in preostes canne.
Ein Klostervorsteher reinige sich in [derselben Form wie] Priesters Reinigung.
The head of a monastery is to clear himself in [the same form as] a priest’s exculpation.
The head of a monastery shall clear himself by the formula used by a priest.
The head of a monastery is to clear himself with a priest’s exculpation.
The head of a minster should exculpate himself as per a priest’s exculpation.

note.seg: Vgl. Gl Kirchenherr 2f. Noch im 11. Jh. heisst der Vorsteher des Stiftskapitels ealdor(man); ebd. 5a
Cf. Gl Kirchenherr 2f. As late as the 11th cent. the head of a collegiate chapter is called ealdor(man); ibid. 5a

note.label: exculpation.
note.seg: This could also mean with a priest’s cognizance.
